title: The Poisonwood Bible
author: Barbara Kingsolver
summary: In 1959, a fervent Baptist missionary drags his wife and four daughters to a village in the Belgian Congo. The women narrate in turn as the family unravels and the country around them moves toward independence.
readIf: you want a layered family story that also looks critically at colonialism and good intentions.
skipIf: you want a quick read, since the middle section is slow and the tragedy is deeply felt.

pairings.reason: Shows the colonial encounter from the other side, in a short and powerful African classic.
Another African-set family story through political upheaval, told by an author from the region.
A much shorter and more famous account of outsiders in Africa, whose attitudes this book quietly answers.
